data.body: Remediation of the missing completion attestation (bug 96d1-6ccf-c73a-485d): this epic originally closed 2026-08-03 with a PASS COMPLETION_VERDICT but NO signed completion attestation — 4 pre-330c children (433c, 9d07, a584, d3ed) read stale-material after bug 330c's checkbox-normalization landed without grandfathering, so certifiable=False silently skipped signing. Fix landed on main (Gerrit change 1360, commit 357d8f6457, rebar-ticket 96d1-6ccf-c73a-485d): compute_validity now grandfathers pre-330c attestations whose signed hash byte-exactly matches the legacy (non-normalized) recomputation. With the children reading certified again, this epic was remediated via the codebase-sanctioned recovery path (reopen -> fresh plan-review PASS -> claim -> re-close): the completion verifier re-ran, PASSED, and the signed completion-verifier attestation is now present and valid in the attestations map.
